# Data card, short form

**Provenance.** Generated by the repository's example builder on 2026-09-10. No
measurement of anything real.

**Composition.** 12 synthetic units, one score each. The unit of independence is the
unit; there are no repeated measurements.

**Processing.** None. The file is written as generated.

**Splits.** None. The example reports a single mean.

**Known limitations.** It is synthetic, so it supports no scientific claim. It exists
to give the verification command something to check.
